description: ROOMS.md 4.2: the signed roster. `records` are as GET /roster returns them, without `signer`. `valid` replays every entry kind; `state` is what replay yields. Each case in `refused` is refused at the 0-based record `first_invalid`, and every record before it stands; `reason` is informative.

steps: genesis: the creator and the custodian, both owners
the custodian makes invite 2, which needs approval
dana joins with invite 2 and is pending
ben's second phone joins with invite 1, its last use

refused.name: a signature with one bit flipped
an entry signed by the right device over another entry
a broken chain: prev names another hash
a dropped entry in the middle
the first entry is not a genesis
a genesis after the first entry
an invite signed by a member
a join whose invite signature is by another key (a relay adding a device)
a join for an invite that is not in the roster
a join past the invite's uses
a join at the invite's expiry
a join under a closed invite
a join that reuses a device id
a pending device signs an entry
a removed device signs an entry
a member removes another member's device
a remove that leaves no owner
a demote of the last owner
a link without the device's own signature
an approve of a device that is not pending
a promote by the device itself
an unknown entry kind
a record whose n is not its position
